verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas offers some data-portability levers—open-source MIT engine (npm-published), a REST API and 'Project Archive and Restore' for paid plans, and open-format splat conversion via SplatTransform—but there's no documented, standardized export of full Editor projects (scenes, entities, scripts) into an open interchange format, and community reports describe real lock-in friction ('all your code needs to live on their server,' 'uploading assets is a deal breaker,' needing third-party playcanvas-sync tooling to mirror assets locally). missing for 10: a documented native full-project export to an open format, first-party guidance for migrating an entire project off PlayCanvas, and resolution of community-reported lock-in/offline friction.
